name: heesch
description: Heesch numbers of unmarked polyforms. Submit a shape (<=200 cells, square/hex/iamond grid) plus a witness patch proving Hc >= k; optionally a partial next corona for defect credit. Score = verified corona count plus fractional progress toward the next ring (the score is not a Heesch number). Class record is Hc = 4; a verified 5 is a research result. Plane-tilers are rejected; scoring never executes participant code.
